Defensive Looping is a DeFi strategy that repeatedly deposits collateral and borrows against it to leverage a position. Defensive Looping increases exposure to liquidation risk when collateral values fall. Defensive Looping is used in the domain to describe risks that may affect consumers.

Private key is a secret cryptographic value that grants control over a crypto wallet. Private key must be kept secret, because anyone holding it can move the associated funds. Private key loss can make the associated funds permanently inaccessible.

Depeg describes a stablecoin losing its intended peg to a reference value such as one US dollar. Depeg can cause holders to suffer losses when the token trades below its peg. Depeg events are used in the domain to warn about risks to stablecoin holders.

Exit Scam is a fraud in which project operators abandon a project and take investors' funds. Exit Scam typically occurs without repayment of users. Exit Scam is used in the domain to accuse developers of intentional theft.

Governance Attack is a manipulation of a protocol's voting process to pass harmful proposals. Governance Attack often involves acquiring a large amount of voting power, for example through borrowed tokens. Governance Attack can lead to the draining of protocol treasuries or user funds.
